title: Why Evangelical Christians Love Israel | VICE on HBO
summary: A VICE on HBO segment in which Thomas Morton joins a tour of born-again Christians in the Holy Land. It examines the end-times beliefs behind evangelical support for Israel.
why: HN commenters point to it to explain the religious motivations behind US evangelical support for Israel.
